items.title: 29.5.1 Infrared spectra samajhna aur andaza lagana (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of interpreting IR spectra (PDF 193).

blocks.text: IR spectrum parhna seekhne ka behtareen tareeqa hal shuda misalein (solved examples) dekhna aur IR spectrum ki khaas nishaniyon se waqif hona hai.

blocks.title: Misal 29.1
blocks.problem: Diye gaye do spectra dekh kar batayein ke kaun sa propan-2-ol ka hai aur kaun sa propanone ka.
steps: Spectrum A mein taqreeban 1710 cm⁻¹ par tez aur nokeeli (sharp) absorption hai. Yeh C=O (carbonyl) group ki nishani hai, jo ketone ka functional group hai. Is liye spectrum A propanone hai.
Spectrum B mein taqreeban 3200−3600 cm⁻¹ par tez absorption hai. Yeh alcohol group (−OH) ki nishani hai, jo propan-2-ol mein hai. Is liye spectrum B propan-2-ol hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in wavenumbers ka unit sirf “cm” likhti hai; sahi unit cm⁻¹ hai: 1710 cm⁻¹ aur 3200−3600 cm⁻¹.

blocks.alt: Do infrared spectra, A (oopar) aur B (neeche), dono absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500) par. A mein 3450 ke qareeb chhota jhukao, 3000 ke qareeb tez band aur 1750 ke qareeb bohat tez, nokeela band, phir 1500 se neeche kai bands. B mein 3350 ke qareeb bohat chaura, gehra band, 2950 ke qareeb tez bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: Misal 29.1: infrared spectra A aur B (Misal 29.1 ke saath chhape spectra ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kisi compound ke IR spectrum mein 1715 cm⁻¹ par tez, nokeela band hai aur 3200 se 3600 cm⁻¹ ke darmiyan koi band nahi. Yeh butanone hai ya butan-2-ol?
blocks.explanation: Butanone. 1715 cm⁻¹ ka band C=O ki stretching hai, aur chaure O-H band ka na hona alcohol ko radd karta hai.

items: Taqreeban 1700-1750 cm⁻¹ par nokeela band: C=O (carbonyl compounds).
3200-3600 cm⁻¹ par chaura band: alcohol ka O-H; 2500-3300 cm⁻¹ par bohat chaura: acid ka O-H.
